# Reflective Rock

Reflective Rock is a pale-blue earth pony mare with a brown mane and a lyre cutie mark. She is one of the background guests at the Grand Galloping Gala in My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic. Her design is shared with Lyrica Lilac and Purple Wave, rather than indicating an alternate identity. See the [earth pony character catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mares).

- **Name:** A fandom identifier, listed in quotation marks in the [cutie mark catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_cutie_marks). Its original coiner and any official name remain unverified.
- **Speaking status:** No verified dialogue or individual voice credit. No additional appearances in episodes, films, or comics were established.

## Important moments

- **Grand Galloping Gala VIP guest — [The Best Night Ever](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/The_Best_Night_Ever) (S1E26):** She stands by a table in the VIP area, where Rainbow Dash hopes to socialize with the Wonderbolts. The character catalog indexes her appearance at 09:21, but a video timestamp could not be independently verified. This is her only documented cameo; no character-defining decisions or additional scenes are known.
